subject: general
question: Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam is a famous dancer of _______ dance form of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam** is renowned for his contributions to the **Kuchipudi** dance form.
 
• Kuchipudi is one of the eight major Indian classical dance forms and originates from the state of Andhra Pradesh.
